text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, awesome! Espo's nails are totally on point today, too~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, obviously.
You gotta keep your weapons polished.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Weapons... well,
they've got pretty striking color schemes, don't they?
Vivid colors paired with black.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
――Still, it's really nice.
The design has clean, simple lines,
yet it carries such a strong presence.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! What's with all the nitpickin'?
Can't you just say it looks 'badass' and call it a day?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Looks tough...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Duh, of course! Just think about it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I always serve absolute perfection!
Right down to my sparkling manicured nails!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Not a single flaw or opening! The absolute strongest!!
Come on, visualize it harder!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ――Running with someone like that would make anyone chickened out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way, I think it looks stylish. Totally.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Me too. Her cuticles are well-cared for, so I'd think she's a very meticulous person.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wha-buh-buh...――?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I head toward the cafeteria to grab some lunch.
And just as I finally secured a seat――

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You, dammit, YOU! Look at my nails! You look at this and what do you think?!
choice_data_list: It seems like you take meticulous care of them even on your days off...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...! Right?!
I knew that was the only way!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehh~? Not cute, but what~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, told ya I don't need that crap!
Sheesh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Exactly!
You can't help but applaud all that hard work!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
HAAAH?! I didn't ask for your commentary!
Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Should I make it even more hardcore and spiky?
Like, attach some stones to it...!
